description: Proposes version bumps as pull requests; nothing merges on its own. A release must be two weeks old before it is proposed, the same rule the pins here follow by hand. The stacks' versions.tf and providers.tf are generated by Terramate and skipped here; their sources (*.tm.hcl) are bumped instead, and the drift check regenerates.

customManagers.description: Container images pinned in role defaults as name: "image:tag" (optionally @sha256 digest).
Tool versions marked with a '# renovate:' comment on the line above.
OpenTofu providers in Terramate's sources (the stacks' versions.tf are generated from these, so they are what gets bumped).

packageRules.description: Patch and minor bumps arrive together, one pull request a week.
A major version is its own pull request, read on its own.
Terramate generates the stacks' versions.tf and providers.tf; their *.tm.hcl sources are what gets bumped.
Jinja templates are not real Dockerfiles until Ansible renders them.
required_version is OpenTofu's, not HashiCorp Terraform's; the OpenTofu pins above are tracked instead.
